note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the official front render (42 mm case, official; the lug gap measures 21.0 mm against the official 22 mm). The render's lugs are foreshortened (51.7 mm): the official 53 mm lug to lug is used, symmetric. Heights are a front-relief reading of the official 11 mm. The chapter ring, 1-12 and 13-24 numerals, date window and prints stay in the dial map.

review.subtitle: Hamilton Khaki Field Auto 42 mm, black dial, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 1.
specs: lug gap in the render (22 official)
notes: Built from Hamilton's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference).

Modelled: polished case with the wide sloped bezel, sword hour and minute hands with lume, white seconds hand with a red tip and tail disc, fluted crown, brushed lugs, three-column bracelet with the house curl.
From the photo map: black dial, chapter ring, 1-12 and 13-24 numerals, the date window (8), Hamilton logo, Khaki Automatic, Swiss Made.
The minute hand covers 14 and the hour hand the H of HAMILTON in the render; both are drawn again from the same dial. Heights are estimated (no side photo).
